title: 第九章 人各有志第十章 不识抬举
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: “回殿下，南梁最开始定的质子是二皇子，那位三公主是南梁皇孟绥最宠爱的女儿，南梁皇后所出，由贵妃涂山玉抚养。”
“十多日前，庄圣王带着九位妖王偷偷去了南梁，回来时带回这位南梁三公主。三日后，南梁传出贵妃涂山玉薨逝，涂山府被灭族的消息。”
“属下收到情报，南梁涂山府是被庄圣王和九位妖王灭族的，庄圣王麾下的崩山熊王就死在涂山府。”
萧世安闻言，脸上露出凝重之色。
“涂山一族守护南梁近千年，便是父皇见了也要礼遇几分。庄拓与涂山一族到底有何仇怨，竟要灭了涂山氏满门？”
燕一摇摇头，随后略显迟疑地说道：“庄拓是大昭人，与南梁涂山一族没有任何交集，与涂山一族有交集的是庄拓的师父，大昭前国师南惊尘。南国师与南梁贵妃涂山玉曾同拜于大荒神秘隐修荒山老道门下，两人是世仇。”
“宫变那一夜，前国师南惊尘自绝与观星殿，最后见他的人是庄圣王。或许当时前国师说了什么，才迫使庄圣王灭了南梁涂山府满门，便是连贵妃涂山玉抚养的南梁三公主也没放过，用七根金钉毁了她的根骨。”
萧世安的眼前闪过孟婵玥后背嵌入的七根金钉，四根在两侧琵琶骨，三根在脊椎骨，钉头泛着冷光。还有那双闪烁着复仇火焰的寒冷眼眸，亮得惊人，让他瞬间失了神。
“庄拓心狠手辣，不光毁了南梁三公主的根骨，还以入大昭为质的名义带她回来，将她困在观星殿内。这是有多防备跟涂山一族有关的人！”
“燕一，继续深挖，我要知道南惊尘死前到底跟庄拓说了什么？”
萧世安觉得庄拓这个人比他想象中还要深不可测，他心狠手辣，野心勃勃，他必须防着他一些。
观星殿内，孟婵玥拿着柔软细腻的软棉布将自己负责的紫檀桌椅擦试了一遍又一遍。二丫负责擦拭书架，小豌在不远处机械地擦拭着镂空雕花明窗。
“这日子什么时候是个头啊！”
突然，小豌将手里的软棉布扔到地上，捂着脸哭起来。
二丫在一旁见了，忙走过去提醒她。
“小豌，这里是摘星阁，可不能哭，别惹怒庄圣王……”
孟婵玥握紧双拳，心里也憋屈的厉害。只是看着哭哭啼啼的小豌，她心里对庄拓的恨意更深了。
这一日，孟婵玥等人一直忙碌到子夜时分。待黍管事从袖中抽出一块白绸布擦拭摘星阁内的边边角角，见白绸布上确实没有沾染上任何浮尘后，他才满意地点点头。
“今日就先这样，你们都回去休息吧。”
话音未落，孟婵玥等人就拖着疲惫的身躯往摘星阁外走。
孟婵玥机械地挪动着脚步，她觉得自己手背上的冻疮疼的厉害，七根金钉也在这时候突然往骨头里钻。她眼前一黑，差点摔倒在地，好在走在她身后的二丫及时扶住她。
“婵玥，你没事吧？”
“我没事。”孟婵玥摇摇头，在二丫的搀扶下走进矮房。
“小豌怎么没跟你们一起回来？”二丫扶着孟婵玥坐到床边，抬眼看向后面跟进来的三位宫奴，发现小豌没有跟上来。
“不……不知道！”
三人齐齐摇头，面上却露出几分怯懦。
二丫看着外面的天色，心中着急万分。
content_en:
"Back to Your Highness, the first hostage of Nanliang was the second prince. The third princess was the most beloved daughter of Emperor Meng Sui of Nanliang. She was born to the Queen of Nanliang and was raised by the noble concubine Tu Shanyu."
"More than ten days ago, King Zhuang Sheng secretly went to Nanliang with nine demon kings. When he came back, he brought back the third princess of Nanliang. Three days later, news came from Nanliang that the noble concubine Tushan Yu had passed away and the Tushan Mansion was exterminated."
"My subordinates received information that Tushan Mansion in Nanliang was wiped out by King Zhuang Sheng and nine demon kings. The Bengshan Bear King under King Zhuang Sheng died in Tushan Mansion."
When Xiao Shi'an heard this, his face showed a solemn expression.
"The Tushan clan has guarded Nanliang for nearly a thousand years, and even the emperor has to treat him with courtesy. What is the grudge between Zhuang Tuo and the Tushan clan that they want to destroy the entire Tushan clan?"
Yan Yi shook his head, and then said with a slight hesitation: "Zhuang Tuo is from Dazhao, and has no connection with the Tushan clan of Nanliang. The person who has the intersection with the Tushan clan is Zhuang Tuo's master, Nan Jingchen, the former master of the Dazhao. Nan Guoshi and Tu Shanyu, the noble concubine of Nanliang, once worshiped under the mysterious secluded Huangshan Lao Taoist sect of Dahuang. The two are feuding."
"On the night of the palace change, the former Imperial Master Nan Jingchen committed suicide in the Star Viewing Hall. The last person to see him was King Zhuang Sheng. Perhaps the former Imperial Master said something at that time, which forced King Zhuang Sheng to destroy all the Tushan Mansion in Nanliang. Even the third princess of Nanliang who was raised by the imperial concubine Tu Shanyu was not spared. He used seven golden nails to destroy her bones."
The seven golden nails embedded in Meng Chanyue's back flashed before Xiao Shian's eyes, four on the sides of the bones, three on the spine, and the nail heads glowed with cold light. And those cold eyes flashing with the flames of revenge were so bright that he lost his mind instantly.
"Zhuang Tuo is so cruel that he not only destroyed the foundation of the third princess of Nanliang, but also brought her back in the name of joining Dazhao as a hostage and trapped her in the Star Observation Hall. How careful is this about people related to the Tushan clan!"
"Yan Yi, keep digging. I want to know what Nan Jingchen said to Zhuang Tuo before he died?"
Xiao Shi'an felt that Zhuang Tuo was more unfathomable than he thought. He was ruthless and ambitious, and he had to guard against him.
In the Star Observation Hall, Meng Chanyue wiped the red sandalwood tables and chairs she was responsible for over and over again with a soft and delicate cotton cloth. Erya was responsible for wiping the bookshelves, while Xiaowan was mechanically wiping the hollow carved windows not far away.
"When will this day end?"
Suddenly, Xiaowan threw the soft cotton cloth in her hand to the ground, covered her face and started crying.
Erya saw her at the side and hurriedly walked over to remind her.
"Xiaowan, this is the Star Picking Pavilion. Don't cry. Don't make King Zhuang angry..."
Meng Chanyue clenched her fists, feeling extremely aggrieved. Just looking at the crying Xiaowan, her hatred for Zhuang Tuo deepened.
On this day, Meng Chanyue and others were busy until midnight. After the steward took out a piece of white silk cloth from his sleeve and wiped the corners of the Star-Zhaing Pavilion, and saw that there was indeed no dust on the white silk cloth, he nodded with satisfaction.
"That's it for today, you all go back and rest."
Before the words were spoken, Meng Chanyue and others dragged their tired bodies out of the Star-Zhaing Pavilion.
Meng Chanyue moved her steps mechanically. She felt the frostbite on the back of her hand hurt terribly, and seven golden nails suddenly drilled into the bone at this time. Her vision went dark and she almost fell to the ground. Fortunately, Erya, who was walking behind her, caught her in time.
"Chanyue, are you okay?"
"I'm fine." Meng Chanyue shook her head and walked into the small room with Erya's support.
"Why didn't Xiaowan come back with you?" Erya helped Meng Chanyue sit on the edge of the bed. He looked up at the three palace slaves who followed behind and found that Xiaowan had not followed.
"No...I don't know!"
The three of them shook their heads in unison, with a hint of cowardice on their faces.
Erya looked at the sky outside, feeling extremely anxious.
